text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Bubble Gum 
Fellow—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days of fighting on the front lines to 
take the racing world by storm have come 
to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, the possibilities she has 
unlocked have no end."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Proof of a new strength, forged and 
realized. That path forward is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even now, she continues to give dreams to 
the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Rounding the fourth corner!! They're 
heading into the homestretch! It's a 
packed field!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Symboli Kris S! Symboli Kris S is coming 
up as well!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――――Target in sight.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S! It's Symboli Kris S! 
Across the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She did it, Symboli Kris S! She has no 
need for the Kikuka Sho title! It is the 
shield of the Tenno Sho that Symboli Kris 
S wanted!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa!! A Classic-class Umamusume just 
won the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!! Is this the 
first time since Bubble Gum Fellow?!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S is seriously strong...! 
She's definitely gonna shake up the era 
from here on...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Strong Umamusume aren't just coming out of 
the Classic races, huh...! There's gonna 
be more and more of them from here on 
out...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —...It really warms the heart, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
To have someone proving their strength on 
a path so similar to mine.
choice_data_list: It's all because Bubble paved the way

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Free from existing conventions, on a stage 
where one can purely showcase their utmost 
strength, demonstrating full power and 
inspiring dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That way of being was undeniably forged 
and demonstrated to the racing world by 
Bubble Gum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...So that's how it stays behind, huh.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
All the days I've spent running up until 
now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And— it connects to a new strength... 
toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: —We made it—!! Dubai—!! Yeeeah!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
We didn't come here to play around, Lapis. 
This is an inspection tour.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, Cure-chan. We need to properly 
inspect the recreation spots too!"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"In the future, the Dubai international GⅠ 
races are definitely going to be 
critically important...!"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta make sure we have a blast out 
there and take on the race in the best 
mood possible!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. So you've actually put some 
thought into it.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
How rude! I'll have you know I'm the 
turf-and-dirt dual-wielder of the "Four 
Heavenly Kings"! I carry out my duties 
with pride every single day!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Now, our dear tactician. Let's go-go to 
the hotel! By the way, where is it? Lead 
the way~!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: ...I take that back.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
—That's all for the morning track 
training! Everyone take a break and 
prepare for the afternoon menu!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...A stellar lineup this year too, I see.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Triangle Hairpin
text_block_list.text: —Um, Coach Waltz.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Triangle Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
—I'm thinking of taking the entrance exam 
for Tracen Academy next year.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...! ...I see. You've made your decision.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Triangle Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My coach always taught me that it's a 
fiercely competitive world. But that's 
precisely why—I want to take on the 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Triangle Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
And someday... I want to run in the Kikuka 
Sho just like Coach...! And put on an 
amazing race...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Triangle Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Can I... do it too?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: You can do it. I know you will. So—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Nurture that dream and cherish it dearly.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Because it will surely... become your 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Air Groove-senpai? What are you doing 
in a place like this—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dober. ...I was just reading some 
letters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened. ...You look 
somewhat happy about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It is from one of the students at my 
mother's racing academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she's enrolling in Tracen 
Academy next year to follow after me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wah...! What a wonderful story...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I talk with my juniors, I 
often have my eyes opened as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's still no end to the girls who 
enroll in the academy out of admiration 
for Air Groove-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If that is the case, it is everything I 
could hope for.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Because that is the way I strove to be as 
the 'Empress'—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My way of being will become the "ideal," 
and in order to surpass that "ideal," the 
next generation will blaze their own 
trails.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Connecting one by one, they sprout into 
countless possibilities— a future where 
unseen flowers bloom in full glory—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It sounds lovely. A future brimming 
with vibrant colors, I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...It is my "ideal," which still 
continues to grow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However— don't you forget it, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That you, too, are a single blossom 
blooming proudly beyond me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dreams, the future, they expand. And 
they keep on expanding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Today, and tomorrow as well. Inheriting 
the passion from the past."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if... it should pop and vanish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“And someone like ‘her’ makes it swell 
even further—”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —You've made it this far, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dream of the Japanese racing world. 
Right now, she and I stand at its very 
forefront.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"The strength we have shown, the 
possibilities we have carved out—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—It might lead to a future where the 
world's greatest Umamusume emerges from 
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“――――Goal in!! This is the strength the 
whole world looks up to!! Proof that she 
is the strongest in the world!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because Bubble Gum Fellow and I are still 
blowing up our dreams, even now."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes. You're always allowed to let your 
dreams grow.”
choice_data_list:
You can let it swell as much as you want, 
as many times as you want.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And... the one who will fulfill that dream 
is—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"That day... The power to keep inspiring 
dreams was—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You believed that it was definitely inside 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――She runs.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Now, Bubble Gum Fellow. Carrying the 
dreams of the Japanese racing world, he 
now enters the gate for the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...As the vanguard for Japanese Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As one who fosters an immortal 
dream――――!!!
